about: Malformed inputs for the readers reachable from the tools in this folder and for the map, object, trigger and script parsers the published exe ships. SEC-08 names the corpus, the residual risk in wc3-spec-parsers-v1.md names what it does not reach. A case naming the exe_tool parser starts the published server and calls one tool with one malformed map, as a folder or as an archive file.
